purpose: Wave-0 source identity and cohort-selection contract. This file does not claim that external data has been downloaded or frozen.

acquisition_policy.local_copy_policy: Record exact original filename, local path, license or terms, preprocessing, units, and SHA-256 before use.

selection_rules: approximately 30-150 residues for the first feasibility cohort
PDB chain and experimental construct identity are resolvable
measured folding rate and, where available, unfolding rate
temperature, pH, buffer, denaturant, and measurement method recorded
exclude disulfide-rich, multi-domain, membrane, ligand-dependent, and aggregation-dominated cases from the first cohort

source_records.citation: KineticDB curated protein folding and unfolding kinetics
source_records.license_or_terms: Review source and data-use terms before packaging a local copy.
source_records.unit_convention: Preserve source rate units and record any log-rate transformation explicitly.

source_records.license_or_terms: Review source and data-use terms before packaging a local copy.
source_records.unit_convention: Preserve temperature, denaturant, rate, and free-energy units as declared by the source.

source_records.license_or_terms: Review source and data-use terms before packaging a local copy.
source_records.unit_convention: Record any temperature correction and Eyring/Kramers conversion separately from source values.

source_records.license_or_terms: Check current RCSB/PDB data-use and redistribution terms for each packaged entry.
source_records.unit_convention: Coordinates retain source units; topology preparation must record every transformation.

source_records.license_or_terms: Check current CASP access and redistribution terms before using a holdout package.
source_records.unit_convention: Coordinate and evaluation units follow the declared CASP package.

forbidden_substitutions: Do not treat AlphaFold output as folding kinetics or a cellular trajectory.
Do not treat the finite HP input as a real protein structure dataset.
Do not fill the 12-protein cohort with synthetic or convenience rows.
Do not call a source record, citation, or local summary a measurement.
claim_boundary: The source package is source-referenced only. No real protein cohort, PDB/CASP validation, experimental validation, or external replication is claimed.
